venue.subject: Jake Essex for The Half Moon?

messages.subject: Jake Essex for The Half Moon?
messages.body:
Hi Nina,

I'm Natalie — I look after bookings for Jake Essex.

Jake would be a great fit for The Half Moon. That Putney stage has always
been for nights where the voice does the heavy lifting — and Jake’s the
real deal: classic 50s–70s, no tribute, no gimmicks, just a proper singer
who holds the night. He’d love to come and perform for you.

He's performed in over 500 venues over the past 10 years and built a good
reputation for singing the classics without the corny impersonation. He's
branching out to new venues now.

Jake is a professional solo vocalist from Essex. 50s, 60s and into the 70s
— Darin, Dion, Holly, Orbison, Sinatra, Elvis & more. He is the act — no
tribute, no jumpsuit, no corny impersonations. Own PA, fully
self-contained, no deposit.

Have a look: www.jakeessex.co.uk

Saturdays, Sundays and functions this year and into 2027 — if a date works,
reply here and I'll lock it.

Natalie
